messages:
harper: Noticed a weird transient spike in per-token cost for route r-721 during yesterday's staged rollout. Peak ~2.8x for ~20m. traffic constant. anyone grok this?
mina: yep saw it on the cost heatmap, cache_hit collapsed from ~88% -> 15% at 02:14 UTC. chart shows a long tail after canary started which made PMs think it was a regression.
ryan: my hunch is cache lineage didn't carry over and the requests drained to a cold hotpath where quantized kernels are more expensive. we also currently collapse model_variant in some rollups which hides whether traffic hit a different billing_bucket.
tara: telemetry gap: token samples lack billing_bucket and often miss route_id for low-weight samples. hard to attribute. proposal: add fields -> route_id, model_variant, billing_bucket, is_canary, sample_weight. Example (plain text):
  token_sample route=r-721 model=zephyr-32k-v3 billing_bucket=sku-a100-hotpath is_canary=true tokens=14 cache_hit=false sample_weight=12
telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: recommend upping sample_weight x5 for canaries for the first 60m to reduce estimate variance.
harper: console UX idea: add a Cost Sidepanel in the rollout flow that shows 3 cards: "Projected unit cost (30/60/120m)", "Warmup tax & duration", "Bucketed SKU exposure". show confidence bands and link to the per-route bucketed drilldown.
mina: +1. Also suggest the per-route list get a tiny badge when a canary is active: "warmup 18m (proj)" so SREs don't chase a permanent regression.
ryan: infra ask: expose an internal endpoint `/internal/cost_sim` that accepts recent token samples + canary_pct and returns `{projected_unit_cost, warmup_minutes, sku_exposure}` (we'll keep response small). sampling job can upweight canary samples on ingest.
tara: backend note: to save ingest we can upweight rather than fully sample more events. compute job multiplies by sample_weight to produce effective counts. forecasting can be a short ER model over cache_hit trajectory and SKU mix. target latency < 10s for the modal preview.
harper: policies: add an optional "pause_on_cost_surge" checkbox in rollout modal with defaults: threshold = baseline * 2, window = 5m. If triggered, canary pauses and notifies owner. Also show an inline estimate of expected cost if paused vs continued.
telemetry-bot: telemetry-bot: add route_owner to token samples so modal can show on-call/contact link without extra lookups. sample schema change small win.
mina: action items: 1) telemetry schema + sampling guidance (tara/telemetry) 2) cost_sim endpoint spec + quick prototype (ryan/infra) 3) console sidepanel mock + badge + pause toggle (harper/ux). i'll file RFC and tag infra/ux/telemetry.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started route=r-721 -> zephyr-32k-v3 (canary=10%)
harper: thanks everyone. main goals: make warmup visible, reduce pager noise, and give the roller clear rollback/autopause levers.
